object: Whether Nebula can compare financial-market interventions by direction, ranking, mechanism and failure conditions with reviewable evidence.
decision_rule: No aggregate score. A claim may advance only when its own gate passes; engineering integrity cannot substitute for external validity.

verdict.summary: The current product is an engineering prototype with one clean internal A/B. Product validity is not established: no historical, human, prospective or customer-utility benchmark has passed.
verdict.claim_allowed: The system can run and audit a clean recorded scenario comparison.
verdict.claim_not_allowed: The system accurately predicts real market or human responses.

tracks.label: A/B integrity & reproducibility
tracks.question: Do same-seed arms remain identical before the intervention, with versioned inputs and inspectable logs?
tracks.gate: 100% of benchmark pairs pass pre-intervention parity; manifests record population, intervention, mechanism, model, seed, prompt hash and code hash.
tracks.evidence: Current flagship: 2/2 same-seed A/B pairs pass pre-intervention parity; panel is current; required manifest fields are present.
tracks.limitation: This verifies the recorded flagship comparison, not market realism or predictive validity.
tracks.next: Keep parity at 100% for every benchmark case and fail closed on missing hashes or logs.

tracks.label: Mechanism validity
tracks.question: Do the simulated rules and traces implement the intended market mechanism without hidden leakage?
tracks.gate: Contract tests pass for each domain pack and an independent market-microstructure review finds no decision-changing implementation defect.
tracks.evidence: Five books, agent intents, fills, halts and per-agent traces are recorded and inspectable in the current run.
tracks.limitation: The batch-auction mechanism is simplified and has not received an independent market-microstructure validation.
tracks.next: Add domain-pack contract tests and commission an independent microstructure review.

tracks.label: Descriptive market realism
tracks.question: Does the unchanged world reproduce pre-registered stylized facts and distributions?
tracks.gate: On held-out periods, the product matches the accepted tolerance for spread, depth, volume, volatility, autocorrelation and cross-asset responses, and is compared with historical resampling and ABIDES-class baselines.
tracks.limitation: Current simulated paths have not been scored against held-out spreads, depth, volume, volatility or cross-asset distributions.
tracks.next: Freeze a stylized-facts suite and compare against historical resampling and an ABIDES-class baseline.

tracks.label: Historical intervention replication
tracks.question: Can the system recover known directional and ranking effects without seeing the post-intervention answer?
tracks.gate: At least two masked historical interventions are pre-registered and scored on direction, ranking, mechanism and false-positive claims against econometric and analyst baselines.
tracks.limitation: The current wording demo is synthetic and cannot establish recovery of real intervention effects.
tracks.next: Run the SEC Tick Size Pilot and Regulation SHO Pilot as masked, pre-registered replications.

tracks.label: Behavioral grounding
tracks.question: Do agent responses agree with authorized held-out human decisions under matched information?
tracks.gate: A pre-registered holdout reports direction accuracy, total-variation distance, subgroup error and identity drift; synthetic output is never used as the reference label.
tracks.evidence: 0% of persona attributes are grounded in consented real-person data; 0 holdout evaluation(s) registered.
tracks.limitation: Literature priors and synthetic identity cards are not human behavioral evidence.
tracks.next: Run an authorized, matched-information human holdout with pre-registered direction and distribution metrics.

tracks.label: Robustness & sensitivity
tracks.question: Does the decision conclusion survive legitimate seeds, prompts, models and parameter uncertainty?
tracks.gate: Every included A/B pair passes parity; the conclusion and its failure regions are reported over pre-registered seeds, prompts, accessible models and parameter sweeps.
tracks.evidence: Flagship covers 2 clean pair(s). Current quotable sensitivity evidence: 0/4 pair(s) pass parity; 4 fail.
tracks.limitation: The clean flagship uses one model, one prompt and two seeds; contaminated sensitivity pairs cannot support robustness claims.
tracks.next: Re-run a pre-registered GLM seed/prompt/parameter matrix after the gateway fix, then add eligible model baselines.

tracks.label: Prospective / out-of-sample
tracks.question: Does a frozen report remain useful when the real outcome was unavailable at generation time?
tracks.gate: At least one report is timestamped before the outcome, frozen, and later adjudicated against the realized outcome without retroactive edits.
tracks.limitation: No current report was frozen before an unknown real-world outcome.
tracks.next: Freeze one design-partner report before the outcome and adjudicate it later without retroactive edits.

tracks.label: Decision utility
tracks.question: Does the product change a consequential decision or review process better than current alternatives?
tracks.gate: A design partner records the decision, baseline process, action taken, review time and avoided or accepted risk; value is adjudicated by the customer, not inferred from usage.
tracks.limitation: No recorded customer decision, time saving, risk change or paid renewal is attributable to the product yet.
tracks.next: Measure one paid design-partner decision against its existing analyst process.
